hier_cluster_vs_scalar.scope_note: the bootstrap covers only the submetrics that are literally means over samples (0.5875 of the 1.0 module weight). Pooled and per-protein-mean submetrics are not sample means, so resampling samples does not yield a valid bootstrap distribution for them and they are excluded rather than approximated. The CI is therefore a CI on that component of the margin, not on the full total.
